name: Arisawa Mfg. Co., Ltd.
summary: Arisawa Mfg. Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of electronic, display, electrical insulating, display, and industrial structural materials in Japan, China, and internationally. It offers flexible printed circuit materials, including PI, photosensitive, and other materials; copper-clad laminates; interlayer adhesive sheets; and PI composite, protection films, and glass epoxy sheets. It also provides optical materials, such as projection screens, 3D products, optical retardation elements, and film and glass lamination services.
